_doc: Un registro por asset generado de la landing (regla de businext-sys/businext-web-system). Los binarios están commiteados: con API alojada son la única garantía de reproducibilidad.

reference.description: Plancha de personaje (frente, tres cuartos, perfil, espalda) aportada por el cliente. Fuente de identidad para todas las escenas.

concepto: Vuelo continuo por la barbería enganchado al scroll (plantilla narrativa de businext-web-system): 5 planchas por orientación y 4 tramos de vídeo de primer a último fotograma entre ellas. Coste aproximado: 10 planchas + 8 tramos.

assets.alt: Ilustración 3D del barbero con chaqueta de cuero marrón, de brazos cruzados junto al sillón de su barbería al anochecer; sobre el móvil del mostrador flota un anillo de luz turquesa.
assets.provider: Comfy Cloud (partner API: Google Vertex AI)
assets.prompt: Use the character from the reference image exactly: same face, beard, short black fade haircut, brown leather bomber jacket with striped cuffs, white t-shirt, black jeans, black-and-white sneakers. Same stylized 3D collectible-figure render style (soft vinyl toy look, Pixar-like lighting). Setting, identical in every shot: his modern barbershop interior at dusk, dark blue-black walls, one vintage black leather barber chair, a long wooden counter, a big round mirror, thin teal LED strips along the shelves, warm tungsten pendant lamps. Scene: he stands confidently next to the barber chair, arms crossed, slight smile, a calm owner. On the counter beside him his smartphone lies face up and a soft teal holographic ring of light hovers above it, the AI that runs the shop. Cinematic wide 16:9 shot: the character and the action in the right half of the frame, generous calm dark empty space on the left 45% for headline text and interface panels. Moody dark palette (near-black blue #0c1117) with teal (#41d9d6) accent light and warm tungsten glow. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names anywhere; screens and holograms show only abstract shapes.
